heard: NASA fixed a jammed spacecraft millions of miles from Earth. In deep space, Galileo's primary main antenna jammed shut. Without that dish, beaming photos from Jupiter seemed impossible. Engineers at Mission Control tried every trick to unlock it. And when physical fixes failed, they completely rewrote the probe software. They beamed the new code across hundreds of millions of miles. The software compressed data so the weak backup antenna worked. That code saved the mission, revealing ocean worlds around Jupiter. No human could ever reach the broken dish in deep space.
